dimensions.evidence: Observed handle2,ticket16,heap336,cell20 bytes. A copied handle is an inert identity; pin ticket names a central OwPin control.
Both pending jobs own one explicit root. Pin adds raw-span retention and reserves object7 physical position; rooted handle allows its identity entry to redirect.

Root transfer retains then releases the original owner. Synchronous job completes all reads before pin finish; final roots released and all4survivors reclaimed. Real async join remains separate campaign evidence.
Read-only payload; packing may rewrite only unpinned cells. Handle lookup/copy is serialized with packing in this probe; no unprotected concurrent metadata access.
Eight preallocated typed cells; no allocator call in either job path. Full/lease exhaustion semantics are tested separately; this cost workload uses admitted capacity.
Per1000 jobs handle path moves4000cells; pinned path3000. Handle reads copy1000*length*reads payload bytes; pin direct reads copy none during access but still pay setup/packing/control work.
Every pin finishes after synchronous quiescence; every root released; final collection reclaims4cells/job. No destructor recursion or timed asynchronous join.
Actual existing orx_read/orx_foreign_begin/orx_pack/orx_foreign_finish with actual T66 ownership.c, compiled separately. Probe source does not replace those mechanisms.
No parallel speed or simultaneous access claim from the timing probe. Actual backend cancellation/join and TSan evidence remain in the source-bound family campaign.

Equal admitted-state workload checks every returned status and cleanup count. Existing failed-capacity/stale-ticket tests remain necessary; successful timing runs alone do not establish failure atomicity.
Exact six configurations plus clean/no-change/one-header rebuilds recorded by the source-bound probe. No cross-machine compilation ranking.
Actual size/disassembly/.su artifacts retained for all six configurations. Whole-image includes original runtime, typed pool and T66 ownership; local frames are not whole-program bounds.

Host synchronous job contract, immutable payload and stable handle authority. No persisted pointer ABI, physical timing or hardware-counter claim. Relocation freedom differs and is reported explicitly.

observation: 1080retained samples+72warmups;1000full jobs/sample; two lengths and three read counts. Same checked payload/ownership/cleanup outcomes, different declared relocation policy. Raw measurements remain authoritative; no universal winner inferred.

sealed_decision.choice: Prefer copied rooted identity when consumer can use handle lookup and movement is useful; pin only at an explicit raw-span boundary with established quiescence.
sealed_decision.reason: The handle preserves relocation freedom but adds resolution/payload-copy work; pinning avoids repeated copies while retaining a physical slot.
sealed_decision.reopen_when: Change payload mutation, asynchronous backend lifetime, heap compaction policy or consumer access API.
